name: fizzl
description: Check before an agent pays or signs: x402 Doctor (is this x402 or MPP API safe to pay, does my paid endpoint work) and presign-guard (is this transaction, approval or token safe). Plus Fizzl Buy (live data bought in one call), the Fizzl Agent Wallet (spending limits) and Ichimoku Signal (crypto trend signals).

plugins.name: x402-doctor
plugins.description: Before paying an x402 or MPP API: a free 30-day track record, then a $0.001 go / caution / no_go verdict. For your own paid endpoint: a free check with a fix hint per problem. Two skills plus Doctor's MCP server.

plugins.name: presign-guard
plugins.description: Before an agent signs a transaction, approval, Permit or x402 payment, buys a token or sends funds: green / orange / red with reason codes, OFAC sanctions screening included. EVM, Solana, XRP Ledger and Algorand. One skill plus presign-guard's MCP server.

plugins.name: fizzl-agent-wallet
plugins.description: Give your agent a wallet with spending limits: it pays x402 and MPP APIs and sends USDC within your rules, asks on your phone above them, and every signature is checked by presign-guard first. One skill that walks the owner through setup (the wallet's MCP server needs the owner's own keys, so it is installed separately).

plugins.name: ichimoku-signal
plugins.description: Crypto trend signals for trading and research agents: Ichimoku on any timeframe, a six-indicator confluence, levels with a trade plan, a 148-coin scan and ranked setups, with a news-risk flag. Free daily trend; paid calls over x402 or MPP. One skill plus Ichimoku Signal's MCP server.

plugins.name: fizzl-buy
plugins.description: Live data your agent can't get itself (weather, prices, exchange rates, search, news) bought in one call: Fizzl picks the x402 seller x402 Doctor has seen paying out day after day at a fair price, pays it and returns the answer, checked for hidden instructions. $0.02 per purchase over x402, nothing charged when no seller delivers; a free preview of the pick. One skill plus Fizzl Buy's MCP server.
